title: Authoritative document metadata
description: Provenance record for a single authoritative document version. See docs/design/01-provenance-schema.md. Every required field must be populated before a document enters the authoritative layer. Verification refinement (2026-07-02): optional 'verification' (object) and 'corrections' (array) fields record fidelity verification and documented text corrections; the text and its hashes remain the source of truth and Git preserves every prior state.

version_id.description: Version identifier, usually a date, e.g. 1967-01-27

document_type.description: Free-form document type for your domain (e.g. statute, regulation, directive, guidance, standard). Used to group instruments on the generated site.

authentic_languages.description: ISO 639 codes of all languages in which the instrument is authentic

adoption_date.description: ISO 8601 date or null (with reason in provenance_note)

language.description: ISO 639 code of the stored text.txt

license.description: Terms governing the SOURCE text, e.g. UN-materials-terms, public-domain-gov

binding_force.description: Legal force of the instrument on its own accord: binding or non_binding (recommendatory soft law). Orthogonal to authoritative_status; tier is DERIVED from jurisdiction downstream.

issuing_authority.description: Body that made/adopted the instrument. Distinct from source_publisher (where the text was obtained).

administering_authority.description: Body that administers/enforces the instrument where different from the issuer; null if not applicable.

akn_uri.description: Akoma Ntoso Naming Convention Work-level identifier, or null where no conformant one exists. Shared by every language version of the instrument — language belongs to the Expression, not the Work. Minted deterministically by scripts/akn.py from schema/akn-registry.json; never hand-written.

akn_expression_uri.description: AKN Expression identifier: the Work URI plus the ISO 639-2 language. Null where the Work could not be minted, or where the record's language cannot be expressed in ISO 639-2 (which has no script or region subtag).

akn_uri_basis.description: Why the identifier looks the way it does — or why there isn't one. 'none' means no conformant country code exists for the issuing body (the ISA, ITLOS, the ATS Secretariat, CCAMLR): permanent, and not something to paper over with an ISO user-assigned code. 'unmapped' means the registry does not cover this yet: our backlog, and it should trend to zero. Collapsing the two would hide the actionable one.

akn_uri_note.description: Required whenever basis is 'none' or 'unmapped': states the reason. An unexplained absence is indistinguishable from an oversight.

allOf.$comment: If authoritative_status is authoritative_missing there is no stored text, so text_sha256/text_fidelity are not required; otherwise they are.
basis 'none'/'unmapped' requires a null akn_uri AND a non-empty note. Enforced here so a record cannot claim a decline while carrying an identifier, even if it bypasses akn.py.
